caption: The drawing depicts a metallic object consisting of two main components joined at a central axis, symmetrical in structure. Each side of the object features a circular ring at the top, elaborately designed vertical arms with cutouts and gear-like shapes, and decorative elements that suggest crafted detailing. There are coiled components, colored orange, attached to the upper part of the object, wrapping partially around the vertical arms. At the base, each side terminates in a hooked extension, with short segments of chain links attached. The primary color of the object is metallic grey, with some areas appearing darker, possibly indicating rust or wear, and the orange coloring of the coiled sections provides contrast. The object is centered on an off-white or lightly speckled beige background, with the artist's name, "Arthur F. Reynolds," inscribed below the object in small letters. There is no additional context or background imagery present.
